info.name: Shopify Admin REST About Payouts API
Shopify Retrieves A List Of All Payouts Ordered By Payout Date

params.name: since_id
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made after the specified ID.

params.name: last_id
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made before the specified ID.

params.name: date_min
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made inclusively after the specified date.

params.name: date_max
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made inclusively before the specified date.

params.name: date
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made on the specified date.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter the response to payouts made with the specified status.
